plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official CMU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin 'Computer Science Major, B.S.' page for all major course codes, titles and credits (Required I 37 hrs, Required II 13 hrs, Required III 3 hrs, Required IV 4 hrs, 6 hrs CPS/ITC 280+ electives); (2) the official CMU 2025-2026 bulletin University Program group pages (Groups I-IV) and Competencies pages for all gen-ed course codes, titles and credits. CPS 270 fills Required III; PHY 130QR fills Required IV; MTH 132 in the major satisfies the Math/QR competency. Writing Intensive (6 cr): ENG 234WI + HST 222WI. SEMESTER ARRANGEMENT IS A CONSTRUCTED SAMPLE SEQUENCE - CMU's official Major Map PDFs are auth-gated (SharePoint login); an advisor should verify the sequence. Prerequisites are not encoded beyond natural course-numbering order; see the bulletin for official prerequisites. 63 major + 9 competencies + 27 UP = 99 specified; free-elective choice slots (21 cr) reach the 120-credit minimum.
